mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS signup_date, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM user WHERE created_at >= #{startDateTime} AND created_at < #{endDateTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY signup_date ASC

SELECT kb_product_data_version_id AS product_data_version_id, version_code, data_date FROM kb_product_data_version WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY data_date DESC, completed_at DESC, kb_product_data_version_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'DEPOSIT' THEN 1 END) AS deposit_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'SAVINGS' THEN 1 END) AS savings_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'ETF' THEN 1 END) AS etf_count FROM kb_product_version pv JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id WHERE pv.kb_product_data_version_id = #{productDataVersionId}
